decisions.reason: This single handle design involves limited sunk investment, and the firm already cut similar designs, so withdrawal is plausible; still, it fits the core offer and its absence from the website in 2020-21 may be a visibility gap, so the firm keeps it for now.
The multi-model lever family represents tooling and catalogue investment and supports the system-breadth strategy, so management persists despite pruning other handle lines.

The L700 electronic access system is the publicly announced flagship of the firm's digital building direction with heavy R&D and patent investment, so any weak results would be attributed to temporary market causes and the commitment maintained.
